findings.current: No—more precisely, she and I, now close enough to touch.
findings.defect: “Close enough to touch” makes the distance shorter than the source establishes.
findings.rationale: 코앞까지 다가온 conveys that Jin has come right up to her, but the passage later specifies that nearly one jang still separates them.
findings.replacement: No—more precisely, it was just her and me, now almost face-to-face.
findings.source: 아니, 정확히는 어느덧 코앞까지 다가온 나와 단둘이.

findings.current: With them wrapped tight around my limbs, waist, and neck, I reached out and tore them apart.
findings.defect: The pressure Jin feels from the coils is omitted.
findings.rationale: 전해지는 압박감에 explicitly connects the roots’ constriction to his response.
findings.replacement: Feeling the pressure of the roots wrapped tight around my limbs, waist, and neck, I reached out and tore them apart.
findings.source: 사지 는 물론 허리 전체와 목을 칭칭 휘감은 그것으로부터 전해지는 압박감에, 나는 손을 뻗어 그대로 잡아 뜯었다.

summary: Two localized fidelity issues: the draft narrows the distance between Jin and the Grand Mage and omits the pressure of the binding roots.
